qa_pairs.question: Which component in the injection pump drive section has the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The toothed belt pulley to injection pump at 50 Nm

qa_pairs.question: How many components are listed under the injection pump drive section?
qa_pairs.answer: Three components: chain sprocket to injection pump, toothed belt pulley to injection pump, and chain tensioner
